_help: Everything about your cards site lives in this one file. Change a value, save, then refresh the page. In any line, {event}, {year}, {place} and {date} fill in from the event section. Colours are hex codes (#rrggbb). Fonts are any font name from fonts.google.com. Easiest way: tell Claude what you want changed.
